title: Five features that were not actually working, and an easier setup
changes: Fixed: reaction roles never worked. Reacting to a panel did nothing, on every server, since the feature shipped. If you set one up and quietly gave up on it, it works now

Fixed: strike timeouts and bans never happened. The bot said the punishment was set and then did nothing at that strike level. Kick and No Action were fine. Worth checking your strike settings and re-picking the punishment
Fixed: Anti-Promoting said it needed no setup while being switched off. Its own page now shows whether it is on and lets you turn it on there

Fixed: the verify button was posted as soon as you picked the channel, before you had chosen the role to give people. Anyone who used it in that gap was told they were verified and got no role. The button now waits until both are set
Fixed: ticket support reported itself as finished when no panel had been posted, so members had no button anywhere. It now tells you the panel is still missing
Setup no longer sends you away. Picking General Settings used to tell you to go run another command and start over. It just works now
Back to Setup stays on every screen, so setting up three features no longer means typing /setup three times
The verification menu shows what you have already done, instead of looking identical whether you had finished a step or not
